text:
Elle (Design): tiny but important: axis labels on the model-latency chart are misaligned when we abbreviate units. '1.0K' sits slightly off the tick, looks sloppy in the console. Can we ensure labels snap to ticks and align center?
Marco (Frontend): alignment issue likely from our formatter returning strings with width variability. Best fix: snap numeric tick values to 'nice' steps (1,2,5 * 10^n) and render labels from numeric positions rather than relying on preformatted ticks. That should center them.
Jun (Data): agree on snapping. We'll compute tickSteps client-side using magnitude of max value. Also a request: for compact dashboards, don't show decimals (1K not 1.0K). full chart can keep 1.23K if user zooms.
Roshni (Product): copy change: toggle should be "Units: Smart | Full" (Smart = humanized). Earlier terminology 'Auto / Raw' confused support. Smart/Full reads better to external users.
Elle (Design): Smart/Full is fine. Add hover help for Smart: 'Smart: abbreviates large numbers (K, M), no decimals in compact views.' Keep it one-liner.
Marco (Frontend): implementation detail: tick snapping snippet I'll prototype: ```js
function niceStep(max) { const pow = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(max))); const candidates = [1,2,5].map(c=>c*pow); return candidates.find(c=>c*5>=max) || candidates[candidates.length-1]; }
```
That gives ~5 ticks.
Jun (Data): smoothing discussion: ops flagged that our spline smoothing introduces fake troughs after sharp drops. Proposal: default smoothing=none; add 'Smooth: Soft (preserve peaks)' option that uses a peak-preserving filter (e.g., tuned Savitzky-Golay). Document clearly that smoothing may change local extremes.
Roshni (Product): default to fidelity (no smoothing). Put a small 'soft' badge next to smoothing when enabled with tooltip "May alter peak/trough values."
Elle (Design): outlier handling: UX confusion when a single spike makes the whole chart flat. Ops wants clamp, analytics wants to see spikes. Proposal: clamp to 99th percentile by default and visually indicate clamped points as small outlier markers on top of the chart; provide legend action "Reveal full range (includes outliers)" to show true scale.
Jun (Data): we can compute percentile client-side for preview tiles; server authoritative for exports. Also add an option 'overlay outliers' that keeps scale but draws outliers as glyphs so context isn't lost.
Marco (Frontend): UI interactions: legend > kebab menu -> 'Reveal full range (includes outliers)' and 'Overlay outliers'. For keyboard users these items must be reachable and announce state change via ARIA live region.
metrics-bot: note: make sure we wire metric events: legend.reveal_full_range.clicked and chart.overlay_outliers.toggled for AB analysis.
a11y-bot: a11y: fractional pixel gridlines (<1px) render inconsistently; ensure grid color holds 3:1 contrast ratio. Collapsed legends must have accessible name and keyboard focus >=44px target or a 3px visible focus ring. If using icon-only legend, include visually-hidden text for screen readers.
Elle (Design): suggestion: create design tokens grid.weight.micro and grid.weight.standard; micro uses slightly higher alpha to compensate for thinner stroke. Provide color swatches with measured contrast in the design file.
Roshni (Product): rollout: dashboards first behind flag; keep embeds old for one release. AB test: 20% traffic with Smart units + clamp default. Metrics: expand-to-full-chart rate, support tickets mentioning 'missing spike', and perceived readability micro-survey.
Marco (Frontend): perf notes: canvas thin-line rendering vs SVG differ on subpixel; prefer canvas for dense charts and use ctx.translate(0.5,0.5) trick for crisp strokes. Also tick-snap calc is cheap. I'll include perf numbers in RFC.
Jun (Data): for sampled tile previews add microcopy: 'Previewed data, open full chart for complete dataset.' reduces confusion when downsampling hides spikes.
Elle (Design): I'll add side-by-side mocks: Smart vs Full units, clamped vs full scale, and samples with grid.micro vs grid.standard. Mark for design-qa once uploaded.
Roshni (Product): thanks all. please include copy changes in i18n keys: units.toggle.smart = 'Smart' units.toggle.full = 'Full' legend.action.revealFull = 'Reveal full range (includes outliers)'.
Marco (Frontend): will open RFC with code samples and include accessibility checklist + telemetry hooks.
Elle (Design): great. tagging as ready-for-dev after mocks. :white_check_mark:
